profiles.name: Common password but MFA on
profiles.rationale: Guessable password is serious, but MFA blocks most direct takeover; no active lure.

profiles.name: Reused weak password + no MFA, no lure seen
profiles.rationale: Credential stuffing works without any phishing; no MFA leaves no second barrier.

profiles.name: Stalkerware-like calculator

profiles.name: Neglected device (no backup, no updates, no encryption)

profiles.rationale: Active payment-fraud lure with call-back number; money loss is one PIN entry away.
